traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Expecting the worst, anxiety, and worry that mostly never materializes. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for limit against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the limit/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
shadow: Fear and rigidity collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: A plan is not functioning as well as it looks when someone is quietly supplying the missing time, money, labor, or clarity that keeps it alive.

readerCopy.body: A plan is not functioning as well as it looks when someone is quietly supplying the missing time, money, labor, or clarity that keeps it alive. When Saturn squares Neptune, responsibility and idealism create friction until the gap between the vision and the support underneath it becomes harder to cover. Belief in the purpose does not require disguising structural weakness. The arrangement deserves to be judged by what it can carry without invisible compensation.
